title: cystopteris obtusa
intro: Cystopteris obtusa, commonly known as the small wood fern, is a species of fern native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris obtusa include reducing inflammation, fighting against microbial infections, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
